info.name: FRED Maps API (GeoFRED) Categories Tags API

params.name: api_key
params.description: 32-character lower-case alphanumeric FRED API key.

params.name: file_type
params.description: Response format. xml (default) or json. The observations endpoint additionally accepts xlsx and csv.

params.name: realtime_start
params.description: Start of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: realtime_end
params.description: End of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: tag_names
params.description: Semicolon-separated list of tag names to require.

params.name: tag_group_id
params.description: Group identifier for tags — freq, gen, geo, geot, rls, seas, src.

params.name: search_text
params.description: Words to match against tag names and descriptions.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–1000).

params.name: offset
params.description: Non-negative integer offset into the result set for pagination.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field to order tag results by.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order. asc (ascending, default) or desc (descending).

items.docs: Get FRED tags. Optionally filtered by tag names, group_id, or search text.

params.name: file_type
params.description: Response format. xml (default) or json. The observations endpoint additionally accepts xlsx and csv.

params.name: realtime_start
params.description: Start of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: realtime_end
params.description: End of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: tag_names
params.description: Semicolon-separated list of tag names to require.

params.name: exclude_tag_names
params.description: Semicolon-separated list of tag names to exclude.

params.name: tag_group_id

items.docs: Get the related FRED tags for one or more FRED tags. Related tags are tags assigned to series that also have all of the tag_names tags.
